printedPageConvention: pypdf zero-based page index = printed page + 2 (the PDF's one-based page number = printed page + 3).
scope: HSK 3.0 levels 1–6 only. HSK 7–9 task section begins on printed page 45 and is excluded.

extraction.taskAndVocabularyRows: Stable IDs, printed-page locators, and SHA-256 checks of normalized source rows are retained; full source wording is not copied into this repo.
extraction.topicRows: Raw layout-line locators remain alongside geometry-derived tier-cell IDs, parent IDs, printed-page row anchors, cell bounding boxes, and normalized source hashes. Rotated watermark spans are excluded. Page-level geometry and parent continuation were visually reviewed against pp.56–71; individual cell text and educator mapping remain pending.
extraction.grammarPages: All 17 printed-page locators retain page hashes and extracted physical source-row counts. grammarSourceRows records geometry-derived row/page/cell anchors, explicit effective-cell source references with bounding boxes (including inherited cells across pages), and hashes of each source column; no table wording is copied. Page-level row geometry was visually reviewed, including headerless p399. These extraction row counts are not official grammar item counts; individual source text and educator mapping remain pending.
extraction.characterRows: Stable per-level recognition-list IDs and source-row hashes are retained, not a claim of writing proficiency.
